name: Heiligenhaus (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Heiligenhaus (a red roof-shaped chevron with tools on white).
history: The city of Heiligenhaus was most recently granted arms, a seal and a flag on 20 March 1947; the flag is striped in three equal stripes of blue, white and red with the city arms at the centre.

features.role: Heiligenhaus arms — chevron with tools on white
